definitions.explanation: Suffix indicating a person who belongs to an organization or performs a role.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}{員|いん}として{働|はたら}く。
examples.english: To work as a company employee.

notes:
EXAMPLES:
- {会社|かいしゃ}員: company employee
- {銀行|ぎんこう}員: bank employee
- {店|てん}員: store clerk
- {会|かい}員: member
- {駅|えき}員: station staff
